FOCIL `v0.3.0` release: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-focil-devnet%40v0.3.0.

This includes some fixes from `v0.2.0` but also was rebased on latest `forks/amsterdam` which prompted a small change to a test, hence `v0.3.0` instead of `v0.2.1`.
